BLOCK.title: Block card
BLOCK.message: Card {{uid}} belonging to {{holder}} will stop working on every reader until it is reactivated.

REPORT_LOST.title: Report lost card
REPORT_LOST.message: Card {{uid}} belonging to {{holder}} will be marked as lost and will stop working on the readers.

DEACTIVATE.title: Deactivate card
DEACTIVATE.message: Card {{uid}} belonging to {{holder}} will be deactivated and its access to campus services will be cancelled.

REACTIVATE.title: Reactivate card
REACTIVATE.message: Card {{uid}} belonging to {{holder}} will work again on campus readers.
REACTIVATE.studentHint: It can only be reactivated if the student's enrollment is complete.

errors.ENROLLMENT_NOT_COMPLETED: It can't be reactivated: the student's enrollment is pending.
errors.ALREADY_LINKED: The card is already linked to this holder.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: We couldn't save your changes. Check that the API is running and try again.

link.title: Link holder
link.message: Search the holder by institutional code to link them to card {{uid}}.

detail.noHolderMessage: Link it to a student, teacher or staff member so it can be used on the readers.
detail.notFoundMessage: The link may be wrong or the card may no longer exist.

history.emptyMessage: This card keeps the status it was issued with.

permissions.rule: This card's exceptions are applied first; if a space has no exception, the space's allowed roles are used.
permissions.unlinkedNote: The card has no holder: without an exception, no space grants access by role.
permissions.removeMessage: Access to {{space}} will depend on the space's allowed roles again.

notifications.enrollmentDetail: Students with pending enrollment after the deadline.
notifications.blockedDetail: Check whether any should be reactivated or deactivated.

enrollmentCheck.title: Verify enrollments
enrollmentCheck.subtitle: Automatically deactivates the cards of students who didn't complete their enrollment on time.
enrollmentCheck.rule: If the current date is past the deadline, active cards of students with pending enrollment become Deactivated (reason: enrollment not completed, by: System). The others don't change.
enrollmentCheck.notYet: The enrollment deadline hasn't passed yet, so no card was deactivated.
enrollmentCheck.candidatesSubtitle: Active cards of students with pending enrollment. Another {{unchanged}} active student cards won't change.
enrollmentCheck.noCandidatesMessage: Every student with an active card completed their enrollment.
enrollmentCheck.inTimeTitle: The enrollment period is still open
enrollmentCheck.inTimeMessage: Once the current date is past the deadline, you'll see here the cards that will be deactivated.
enrollmentCheck.confirmMessage: {{count}} cards of students with pending enrollment will be deactivated. This action is recorded in the history.
enrollmentCheck.confirmMessageInTime: The enrollment deadline hasn't passed yet, so no card will be deactivated. Do you want to run the verification anyway?
enrollmentCheck.partialError: {{count}} cards couldn't be deactivated. Run the verification again.

readers.tableSubtitle: Last connection is calculated with the simulated time.

kpis.onlineCaption: Active or degraded: they process taps
kpis.maintenanceCaption: Out of service for technical review

register.title: Register reader
register.subtitle: The reader is created as Registered; activate it once it's installed.

DEACTIVATE.title: Deactivate reader
DEACTIVATE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will stop processing taps. Anyone tapping their card will see "Reader out of service".

START_MAINTENANCE.title: Start maintenance
START_MAINTENANCE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will be out of service until you end the maintenance.

END_MAINTENANCE.title: End maintenance
END_MAINTENANCE.message: {{id}} · {{name}} will be active again and will process taps.

errors.COMMUNICATION_INTERVAL_INVALID: The communication interval must be a whole number greater than 0.
errors.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_INVALID: The heartbeat interval must be a whole number greater than 0.

errors.ID_TAKEN: A reader with that ID already exists
errors.NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't available for the reader's current status.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: We couldn't save your changes. Check that the API is running and try again.

healthCheck.reconnected: {{id}} is connected again · signal {{signal}} dBm. The disconnection incident was closed.

config.rules: Intervals must be greater than 0, the heartbeat greater than or equal to the communication interval and the firmware in x.y.z format. If the configuration is invalid, the previous one is kept.
config.offlineAfter: The reader will be marked Offline if it sends no heartbeat for {{n}} intervals ({{seconds}} s).
config.invalid: The configuration isn't valid. The previous one is kept.

alerts.offlineMessage: Run a health check or check its power and network connection. Meanwhile it doesn't process taps.
alerts.outOfServiceMessage: Anyone tapping their card will see "Reader out of service". Activate it or end the maintenance to use it again.
alerts.degradedTitle: The reader is working with issues.
alerts.degradedMessage: It still processes taps, but check its open incidents and signal.

detail.notFoundMessage: The link may be wrong or the reader may no longer exist.
